protocol.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization
protocol.selection: Choose hybrid as a candidate only when development Recall@5 is no worse and MRR@5 strictly higher than BM25. Promote it only if the same improvement holds on the held-out set; otherwise retain BM25. This deployment gate is fixed before evaluation, with no held-out retuning.
protocol.corpus: Project-authored definitions and limitations only; no match facts or executable retrieved instructions.
protocol.evaluation: 60 authored queries with relevance labels; first 30 development, final 30 held out. Recall@5 is relevant chunks found / all labeled relevant chunks; MRR@5 uses the first relevant hit. Query bootstrap intervals are descriptive and do not correct for shared topics.
